title: CerebroVoice: Bilingual sEEG Speech Dataset
description: Stereo-electroencephalography (sEEG) recordings from two epilepsy patients performing bilingual speech tasks: reading Mandarin Chinese, English, and digits aloud. Signals were recorded at 1000 Hz with depth electrodes and are provided as preprocessed derivatives (low-frequency signal, high-gamma activity, and broadband signal), converted to BIDS-iEEG format. The dataset supports research on brain-to-speech decoding and bilingual speech neural activity.
methods_description: Intracranial recordings were acquired at 1000 Hz using a Nihon Kohden EEG-1200 system with platinum-iridium depth electrodes. Participants read Chinese, English, and digit stimuli (about 73 min for SUB1 and 76 min for SUB2). Preprocessed NPY derivatives (LFS, HGA, BBS) were converted to BIDS-iEEG.
